subject: Forecast tilt: quick stage ownership roll-call and commit numbers
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Forecast tilt: quick stage ownership roll-call and commit numbers

Team —

I dug into the week-one forecast and there are a few accounts where the stage mix is skewing our pipe-to-quota math. Before we lock numbers for the weekly finance rollup, I need a quick roll-call on the following:

- For each open deal in your book (top 10 by ARR), confirm current stage, best-case close month, and whether AE is marking as commit this quarter.
- If any deal is being held in a later stage for risk reasons, call it out and add a 1-line mitigation (customer dependency, procurement, legal redlines).

I attached a trimmed pipeline export (pipeline_trim_v2.xlsx) with the accounts I flagged. Please reply inline with your updates by EOD Wed PT so I can reconcile into the model.

No surprises — short bullets are fine. I will assemble and share a reconciled sheet for the leadership review.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

Attachment: pipeline_trim_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:05:23 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecast tilt: quick stage ownership roll-call and commit numbers

Grace —

Thanks for the callout. Quick updates for the rows you flagged (copied the row reference from pipeline_trim_v2):

1) CloudCore / D-2026-3421 (Row 14) — Stage: Contracting (Legal review ongoing). AE: Ben. Best-case close: Nov 2026. Commit?: Yes (pending final SOW). Mitigation: Procurement has an internal budget freeze impacting PO timing; Ben is offering an initial 3-month pilot invoice to unblock legal procurement.

2) Argenta / D-2026-2875 (Row 9) — Stage: Proposal. AE: Logan. Best-case close: Dec 2026. Commit?: No — still needs technical validation from their infra team. Mitigation: Schedule restrictive POC with infra lead next week; if infra sign-off by 11/17 we push to commit.

3) Meridian Health / D-2026-3010 (Row 4) — Stage: Final Demo. AE: Hannah. Best-case close: Nov 2026. Commit?: Yes. Mitigation: Sales to provide signed demo acceptance to procurement.

I attached a small rollforward with my assumed commits for Nov/Dec (commit_rollforward.csv).

Quick note: Argenta represents a $120k upside but has a 60% technical risk — not a reliable commit this quarter unless infra signs off.

Will update rows in the sheet directly if you want me to keep the canonical copy.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

Attachment: commit_rollforward.csv (CSV, 7KB)

Subject: Re: Forecast tilt: quick stage ownership roll-call and commit numbers

Grace / Logan / Hannah —

Adding color from the CloudCore side: procurement@cloudcore.com is the gating dependency. Samir (cc'ed) confirmed procurement will prioritize if we split the PO into two line items (pilot + scale). I expect a signed pilot PO by 11/10 and scale PO by 12/20 if legal finishes review without new SLR asks.

My operational update for the flagged row (CloudCore):
- Committed ARR for Nov (pilot): $45k (marked as commit)
- Remaining ARR potential (scale): $180k (upside, not yet commit)
- Risk: procurement budget true-up meeting 11/9 could delay pilot

Samir, please confirm the procurement timeline or reply with any additional blockers.

Thanks,
Ben

Appreciate the fast responses — this is exactly what we needed. Summary for leadership rollup: 

- Confirmed commits for Nov: CloudCore pilot $45k (Ben) + Meridian Health $220k (Hannah) — to be included in Nov recognized pipeline.
- Upside (not commit): CloudCore scale $180k, Argenta $120k (high technical risk).
- Action owners: 
  - Ben: chase procurement PO for CloudCore; update procurement@cloudcore.com and copy finance when pilot PO is in. Due: 11/10 EOD.
  - Logan: schedule Argenta infra POC and add outcome to the sheet. Due: 11/17 EOD.
  - Hannah: confirm Meridian demo acceptance and upload signed note to the Drive link. Due: 11/9 EOD.

I pulled these into the consolidated tab and updated the committable column. Final reconciled sheet and the model input will be circulated to execs tomorrow AM. If anyone needs a conservative vs. optimistic view split, tell me now — otherwise I'll present the conservative commit and upside bucket separately.

Heads-up: finance will mark Argenta as non-commit for the weekly forecast unless infra sign-off arrives by 11/17.

Thanks again —
Grace
